Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 22
G.N. No. S 279/2000
REVISED EDITION 2002
(31st January 2002)
[1st July 2000]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in Part I of the Schedule and loose-leaf pages of the Act set out in Part II of the Schedule as in force on 1st June 2000:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition and pages of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition and pages of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition and pages of these Acts shall, with effect from 1st July 2000, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
Part I
1.Architects Act (Chapter 12)
2.Bankruptcy Act (Chapter 20)
3.Buildings and Common Property (Maintenance and Management) Act (Chapter 30)
4.Corruption, Drug Trafficking and Other Serious Crimes (Confiscation of Benefits) Act (Chapter 65A)
5.Criminal Law (Temporary Provisions) Act (Chapter 67)
6.Exchange Control Act (Chapter 99)
7.Insurance Act (Chapter 142)
8.Parliament (Privileges, Immunities and Powers) Act (Chapter 217)
9.People’s Association Act (Chapter 227)
10.Petroleum Act (Chapter 229)
11.Probate and Administration Act (Chapter 251)
12.Public Transport Council Act (Chapter 259B)
13.Retirement Age Act (Chapter 274A)
14.Statutory Corporations (Contributions to Consolidated Fund) Act (Chapter 319A)
15.Town Councils Act (Chapter 329A)
Part II
Revised loose-leaf pages of the Central Provident Fund Act (Chapter 36) [Cover page, 37—38, 73 — 78, 81 — 82, Legislative History vii — viii, Comparative Table i — ii]
[G.N. No. S 279/2000]
